segments.text: This is the 6 o'clock news for Tuesday the 10th of December, and first, the headlines.
The Prime Minister has promised to help the drought-stricken farmers in the northern part
of the country who haven't seen rain for nearly three years.
And in Sydney, a group of students are successfully rescued from a plane which landed in the
All miners are on strike in Queensland over a pay claim and the strike looks set to spread
to other states. And on a fashionable note, there's to be a
new look for the staff of Qantas, Australia's national airline.
